events.title: Initial Flooding Across Low-Lying Arteries
events.description: Heavy monsoon downpour (120mm/hr) causes flash waterlogging in Hindmata, Milan Subway, and Sion Circle.

events.title: Building Collapse – Dadar Kabutar Khana
events.description: 3-storey dilapidated structure collapses under heavy rainfall. 18 critical casualties reported.

events.title: Critical Casualty Cluster Reported
events.description: Surge of crush and polytrauma victims identified at Hindmata requiring urgent ICU admission.

events.title: Andheri Subway Flooding (4.5ft Water)
events.description: Subway completely inundated. Vehicles submerged; east-west connectivity severed.

events.title: Hospital ICU Capacity Reduction
events.description: Lokmanya Tilak (Sion) ICU reaches 100% capacity. Diverting all incoming critical ambulances.

events.title: O-Negative Blood Shortage
events.description: City-wide reserves of O-negative blood fall to critical levels (<4 units in central banks).

events.title: Ambulance Breakdown in Flooded Zone
events.description: AMB-04 encounters engine hydrostatic lock near Sion Circle. Mission reassignment required.

events.title: Flood-Zone Casualty Cluster (Hindmata Deep Zone)
events.description: Water rescue boat required for 20 stranded residents with hypothermia and trauma.

events.title: Bridge Closure (Sion-Dadar Flyover)
events.description: Structural joint displacement observed on flyover; police barricade bridge completely.

events.title: Hospital Power Failure (Cooper Hospital)
events.description: Cooper Hospital loses grid power; backup generator operating at 50% capacity.

events.title: Paediatric Surge at Kurla Settlement
events.description: 15 paediatric cases needing urgent specialized pediatric trauma and respiratory support.

events.title: Donor Funds Arrival (₹50,000,000 Released)
events.description: Emergency funds released to logistics pool for fuel, oxygen, and emergency medical replenishment.

events.title: Supply Vehicle Stuck in Mud / Water
events.description: Truck carrying 40 oxygen cylinders trapped in Kurla junction; requires escort or boat transfer.

events.title: Duplicate Beneficiary Claim Detected
events.description: Automated ledger integrity scan detects identical token claim at Dadar and Hindmata relief camps.

events.title: Road Reopening (Bandra-Sion Cleared)
events.description: Pumping stations clear Bandra-Sion corridor. Normal high-speed transit restored.

entries.description: ReliefChain initialized — Mumbai Monsoon Surge Mission Control
Maharashtra SDMA emergency pool ₹10 Cr allocated
₹10 Cr disbursed to Emergency Relief Pool
1,200 IV Fluids released from KEM Central Depot

anomalies.title: Duplicate Aadhaar Token Claim
anomalies.description: Simulated Aadhaar hash 8472-XXXX-9102 filed emergency relief aid at both Dadar Camp #2 and Hindmata Shelter within 6 minutes.
evidence: Timestamp Delta: 6.2 minutes (Physically impossible travel time under current flood gridlock)
anomalies.notes: Automated ledger token flagged for supervisor verification.

anomalies.title: High-Volume Fund Disbursement: F1
anomalies.description: Fund transfer of ₹100,000,000 to Emergency Pool exceeds single-event benchmark ceiling by 160%.
evidence: Approval Chain: Requires multi-sig Comptroller signoff
